headline: Added 9 repos in 5 toolchains (Go x2, cargo x3, pnpm, Python/nox, make-C x2) with 140 validated hidden-test tasks and 115 unsteered Haiku 4.5 sessions (4,073 model calls with per-call tokens/$ and hidden-test outcomes); overall pass rate 64% [57%, 71%], spanning 38–89% by repo; $36.09 of the $45 cap.
metric_name: corpus size and validity (a data deliverable, not a lever)

held_out.note: no lever is evaluated here; these are baseline control outcomes

leave_one_repo_out: n/a (data enables it: every new repository has only unsteered sessions)
vs_baseline: n/a (the corpus grows from 5 repositories (3 Python) to 14, across 5 toolchains)
hard_coded_parts: repos.json setup/hidden commands per repository (measurement instrument)
score.py runnable/count_tests rules for rust, c (janet), make (jq) (measurement instrument)
make_configs --by-size task selection by gold-diff size (sampling choice)
build_recommendation: None for Rust. Use corpus.json: pool by ecosystem to test cross-repo transfer (Go 3 repos, cargo 3, make-C 2, pnpm 2) and use calls.jsonl cum_usd for $/task.
